title: inventory management api should enforce role based access and maintain immutable records
description: Test the inventory management API to ensure it enforces role-based permissions server-side, maintains immutable historical inventory records, and logs all changes for auditability.

title: credit system api should maintain accurate and auditable customer credit balances
description: Verify that the credit system API accurately manages customer credit lines and balances with immutable transaction records and audit logs for all financial changes.

title: ai insights api should generate accurate business analytics and insights
description: Test the AI insights API to ensure it generates accurate and reproducible business insights and analytics based on current and historical data.

title: admin management api should enforce full system access control and audit logs
description: Verify that the admin management API enforces full system access control for super admins, supports user and permission management, and maintains append-only audit logs for all critical actions.

title: team management api should enforce role based permissions and support team member management
description: Test the team management API to ensure it enforces role-based permissions, supports adding, updating, and removing team members, and logs all permission changes.

title: notifications api should deliver alerts and support user notification management
description: Verify that the notifications API delivers alerts correctly, supports user notification preferences, and logs notification events for audit purposes.
